name: 案件別の関係データベース
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. LH09-0049 Japanese two-group relational task database.
Original images1/2 PRIMARY for every icon shape, proportion, stroke/optical weight, table structure, distinct row information, visible state, artwork and fine details. Image3 mock SECONDARY Japanese wording only; do not copy its diamond/symbol substitutes, same green dot for every status, mint initials, duplicated tasks/project links or flattened dates.
Exactly TWO stacked project groups, each 2 rows. Group1 header downward triangle, authentic circled-right-arrow in forest green, underlined「礼拝の準備」, count2, ellipsis, plus. Group2 original multicolor rocket artwork, title「地域の活動」, count2, ellipsis, plus, disclosure. Preserve original rocket appearance and original Jane portrait in all four assignee cells, do not redraw/replace artwork.
Both six-column headers use original Aa/radial/people/calendar/diagonal arrows and Japanese labels「作業名」「状態」「担当者」「期日」「期間」「案件」.
GROUP1 rows:「担当者を招待する」|「未着手」gray dot|portrait「山田 花子」|「2022年10月3日」|walking icon「準備期間 3」|circled arrow「礼拝の準備」.
「準備用の資料を追加する」|「完了」green dot|same assignee/date/period/project.
GROUP2 source task1/task2 translated without inventing content:「作業 1」|「完了」green dot|portrait「山田 花子」|「2022年9月28日」|walking icon「準備期間 1」|original rocket「地域の活動」.
「作業 2」|「進行中」blue dot and label|portrait/name|「2022年9月29日」|walking icon「準備期間 1」|rocket「地域の活動」.
Each group has plus「新しい作業」row and footer「完了 1/2」. Preserve source distinct dates, periods and project association; mock copied them incorrectly.
Thin neutral table dividers, white status pills with fine outline, white canvas/surfaces. Slate #526173 supporting icons, green completed dot/text, blue progress dot/text, gray unstarted; no tinted fills. Meiryo Regular14/24, metadata12/16, tracking0; no heavy title/body or giant heading. Compact original proportions, all Japanese text readable, no added controls/metrics/card/frame.
reviewNotes: Source row1/2 states, distinct dates/periods/projects restored versus mock; two count2 groups and completion1/2. Circled arrows became chevrons, utility glyphs light, portraits synthesized/type heavy; correction pending.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
